newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds strong, Paging Network issue up.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds strong, Paging Network issue up.

text.p: Pent-up investor demand for U.S. high-yield bonds underpinned Paging Network Inc's $500 million debt issue at midday as bonds rose in aftermarket trade, dealers said.

Paging Network's deal, increased in size by $150 million, was actively trading up 1/2 point at 100-1/2 before mid-session. The rule 144A issue of senior subordinated notes due 2008 was priced at par to yield 10.0 percent by co-lead managers Goldman Sachs & Co and Salomon Brothers Inc.
"There was a lot of cash looking for anything high-yield," one trader said. "It's a big issue it still trades up."
